stanza: Then let the dice call the trick
Let the gods take their pick

lilacs.line: And the way their dicks droop like lilacs
stanza: I would rather smell the way boys smell
Way their legs flap under the desk in the study hall
And the way their dicks droop like lilacs
Or the way they smell that forbidden acrid smell

parallax.songTitle: The Island: Come and See; The Landlord’s Daughter; You’ll Not Feel the Drowning
stanza: In the lowlands, nestled in the heath
A briar-cradle rocks its babe to sleep
A foretold rumbling sounds below the deep
